name: giggabit-agent-mail-service
description: Optional Codex integration for the tailnet-only Giggabit Agent Mail Service.

interface.shortDescription: Use explicitly connected mailboxes through the private agent mail service.
interface.longDescription: Lists, reads, organizes, and sends mail through the tailnet-only Giggabit Agent Mail Service. Agents receive short-lived identities and never receive mailbox credentials, OAuth refresh tokens, or host file paths.
defaultPrompt: List the mailboxes and folders I can access.
Find recent messages in my connected mailbox.
Draft an email, but do not send it until I ask.
